classes.admitted_only: admitted key with no lake bar under this rule
classes.lake_only_clock: lake key absent from admitted but its OHLC equals an admitted bar at another hour
classes.lake_only_in_admitted_closure: lake key absent from admitted and inside an admitted closure interval
classes.ohlc_exact: all four OHLC within tolerance on the joined key
classes.residual_clock: joined, not equal, but equal to the admitted bar at another hour (+-1..3 h)
classes.residual_source_all: joined, no OHLC field equal, no neighbour match
classes.residual_source_partial: joined, not equal, at least one OHLC field equal, no neighbour match

evidence_rule: OHLC agreement is supporting evidence only (F04); the key is the declared clock mapping
